quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for thudding feet in unison and a clapped rhythm.
quests.explanation: Feet moving together on a wooden floor to a clapped rhythm are classic sounds of a dance rehearsal.
quests.textToSpeak: Bare feet thud against a wooden floor in unison as a choreographer claps out a sharp, steady rhythm.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a repeated vocal line and adjusted controls behind glass.
quests.explanation: A repeated vocal take and an engineer adjusting controls behind soundproofed glass are signature sounds of laying down a track.
quests.textToSpeak: Behind soundproofed glass, a singer repeats the same line twice while an engineer adjusts a sliding control with careful precision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a steady warning light and a warm greeting.
quests.explanation: A glowing warning light and a host's practiced tone are the clearest signs of a live broadcast in progress.
quests.textToSpeak: A red warning light glows steadily as a host leans into the microphone with practiced warmth.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for murmured scripts and humming fans.
quests.explanation: Many headset conversations murmuring at once under humming computers are signature sounds of this kind of workplace.
quests.textToSpeak: Dozens of headset microphones murmur different scripts at once beneath the steady hum of computer fans.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a creaking band and counted repetitions.
quests.explanation: A stretching resistance band and counted repetitions are classic sounds of a rehabilitation session.
quests.textToSpeak: A resistance band stretches with a low creak as a therapist counts out a slow set of repetitions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a whining blade and drifting dust.
quests.explanation: A whining saw blade and drifting sawdust are unmistakable sounds of cutting wood by hand.
quests.textToSpeak: A saw blade whines through a plank of timber as fine dust drifts down and settles over the workbench.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for rhythmic misting and a squeaking wheelbarrow.
quests.explanation: A misting system watering rows of young plants is a signature sound of this kind of growing space.
quests.textToSpeak: A fine mist sprays rhythmically over rows of seedlings while a wheelbarrow squeaks along a gravel path.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for jangling keys and a sales pitch about features.
quests.explanation: Jangling keys during a sales pitch about a vehicle are familiar sounds of shopping for a car.
quests.textToSpeak: A salesperson jangles a set of keys while describing an engine's features to an interested customer.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for shuffled papers and a confirmed name.
quests.explanation: Nervously shuffled papers and a confirmed name against a list are familiar sounds before a formal meeting.
quests.textToSpeak: A folder of papers is shuffled nervously as a receptionist confirms a name against a short list.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a clicking microphone and many scratching pens.
quests.explanation: A microphone switching on followed by many pens writing at once is a classic sound of a large lecture.
quests.textToSpeak: A microphone clicks on with a soft pop as hundreds of pens begin scratching notes at once.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a buzzer and a jolting carousel.
quests.explanation: A buzzer followed by a jolting carousel starting to move is the clearest sound of this stage of a trip.
quests.textToSpeak: A buzzer sounds once as the carousel jolts into motion, and bags begin sliding down the metal ramp.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a bursting sewing machine and pulled pins.
quests.explanation: A sewing machine running in bursts and pins being pulled from fabric are classic sounds of altering clothing.
quests.textToSpeak: A sewing machine hums in short bursts as pins are pulled one by one from a half-finished hem.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a rapid shutter and a pulsing flash.
quests.explanation: A rapid clicking shutter paired with a pulsing flash is the clearest sound of a professional photo session.
quests.textToSpeak: A shutter clicks rapidly in short bursts while a soft flash pulses and an assistant repositions a large white reflector.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a reversing beep and a scraping ramp.
quests.explanation: A reversing truck and a scraping loading ramp are classic sounds of cargo being loaded or unloaded.
quests.textToSpeak: A truck reverses with a steady beep as a loading ramp scrapes down hard against the concrete.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a humming wheel and rising clay.
quests.explanation: A spinning wheel and clay rising between cupped hands are the clearest sounds of shaping a piece by hand.
quests.textToSpeak: A wheel spins with a low hum as wet clay rises slowly between two steady, cupped hands.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for clicking lenses and a comparison question.
quests.explanation: Clicking lenses and a repeated comparison question are the clearest signature sounds of an eye exam.
quests.textToSpeak: A row of lenses clicks into place one after another as a calm voice asks which looks clearer.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for clinking glassware and a hissing flame.
quests.explanation: Clinking glassware and a hissing flame lit for an experiment are classic sounds of a school science lesson.
quests.textToSpeak: Glass beakers clink gently as a small burner hisses to life under careful supervision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for echoing footsteps and a pointed-out feature.
quests.explanation: Echoing footsteps through empty rooms and a pointed-out feature are classic sounds of viewing a property.
quests.textToSpeak: Footsteps echo through mostly empty rooms as an agent points out a recently renovated kitchen countertop.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for murmuring screens and furious typing.
quests.explanation: Multiple murmuring screens and furious last-minute typing are classic sounds of a working press room.
quests.textToSpeak: Several television screens murmur different channels at once as a keyboard clatters furiously against a looming deadline.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a reversing beep and a heavy thud.
quests.explanation: A reversing forklift beep and a heavy pallet landing are classic sounds of moving stock in bulk.
quests.textToSpeak: A forklift beeps steadily in reverse as pallets are lowered with a heavy, echoing thud.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a brief light and a read-aloud chart.
quests.explanation: A brief light check and a chart read aloud are classic parts of a routine eye examination.
quests.textToSpeak: A bright light clicks on briefly to check each eye while a chart is read aloud from across the room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for unrolling backdrop paper and a last-second adjustment.
quests.explanation: Backdrop paper being unrolled and a last adjustment before a shot are common sounds of preparing a set.
quests.textToSpeak: Backdrop paper unrolls with a long, smooth hiss as a stylist adjusts a collar just before the next shot.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a clanging door and a long timer.
quests.explanation: A clanging kiln door and a long firing timer are familiar sounds of finishing a ceramic piece.
quests.textToSpeak: A heavy kiln door clangs shut as a timer is set for a long, slow firing overnight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a loud clock and a practiced answer.
quests.explanation: A loud clock in a quiet room and a practiced answer are classic sounds of a nervous wait.
quests.textToSpeak: A clock ticks loudly in the silence as someone quietly practices an answer under their breath.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for restarted music and a call to repeat.
quests.explanation: Music restarting from the same point and a call to repeat a section are common sounds of rehearsal.
quests.textToSpeak: A phrase of music restarts from the same bar as a voice calls out for everyone to go again from the top.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for rumbling wheels on a belt and a scanning crowd.
quests.explanation: Rumbling suitcases on a belt and a crowd scanning for their bags are familiar sounds after landing.
quests.textToSpeak: Wheels rumble past on the metal belt as a crowd leans in, scanning for a familiar suitcase tag.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a scanned barcode and a called location.
quests.explanation: A scanned barcode and a called shelf location are familiar sounds of tracking inventory in a large space.
quests.textToSpeak: A scanner beeps against a barcode as a worker calls out a shelf location over the radio.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a shouted correction and a printed draft.
quests.explanation: A shouted correction and a freshly printed draft are familiar sounds just before a story goes out.
quests.textToSpeak: An editor calls out a correction across the room as a printer spits out a final draft nearby.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a warning light and a lone, isolated note.
quests.explanation: A blinking warning light followed by sudden silence and an isolated note is how a professional take usually begins.
quests.textToSpeak: A red light blinks on as everyone falls silent, then a single guitar note rings out, clean and isolated.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a crinkling ice pack and a described pain point.
quests.explanation: A crinkling ice pack and a described pain point are familiar sounds of a recovery appointment.
quests.textToSpeak: An ice pack crinkles as it is applied gently while a patient describes exactly where it still hurts.
